All 14 service files genuinely call `assertCan()`. The three others (`scripts/build-manifest.ts`, `src/actions/_lib/action-errors.ts`, `src/components/domain/permission/permission-gate.tsx`) only mention the name in comments/strings, not actual calls, so they're excluded. Two test files do call it directly.

`assertCan()` in `src/lib/permissions.ts` is the throwing authorization guard (it calls `explain()` and throws `PermissionDeniedError` when the decision is not allowed; `can()` and `explain()` are the non-throwing variants).
